result.summary:
I checked the brief against the repo, the PRD's E1–E7 decisions, ORTAK_CALISMA §3 and §9, mac_env.sh, the Olaylar handover, the UE prototype docs, the icon folder and the promise_break chip code. A fresh session cannot run it end to end as written.

These references are correct: paths, the `live:a4_two_pm` and `a4_eleven` worlds, the three event_chip smoke cases, the promise card ids and option ids (extend, slip, ask_time, drop), the break_plan / _break_parts / satisfaction_after_break chain, the memory files and the 14 frames.

Five defects break execution:
- O1c's only world is an ERP world, so it never shows the B2C-only modules Büyüme and Gelir.
- O1b's fallback points to an upstream icon source that nobody has identified. Where assets/icons comes from is an open owner question and a release blocker.
- There is no working recipe for the required MCP live check. gopeak cannot pass flags or HOME, and every shot quits the game.
- O0 copies four commit tools but they depend on six more. On this Mac they also fail on bash 3.2, a missing `python` and lock checks hardcoded to URUN_ARAYUZU.
- O2 does not name the smoke case that encodes the old rule, does not define the "own share" for a broken promise, and gives no expected after-values.

The co-director can fix everything except the icon-source rule. Whether candidates may come from outside the existing set, and from which licensed source, is Erdem's call (PRD_ANA_MENU_ONBOARDING "Sahibe bırakılan kararlar" 3).

findings.quote: Her aday kümesi için `live:a4_two_pm` TR karesi, ayrıca 2× kırpma.
findings.problem: `a4_two_pm` is an ERP (B2B) world, so its left column shows only Çekirdek, İlk Kullanım, Entegrasyonlar and Güven. Büyüme and Gelir are B2C-only modules and never appear, so two of the four rejected modules cannot be shown in-game at real size, which E4 requires.
findings.evidence: data/product/sprint.json areas: growth markets ['b2c'], revenue ['b2c'], integrations ['b2b']. main.gd `_seed_product_a4` calls `SprintSystem.choose_type("erp", "Fatura")`. The UE page needed `b2c_live` frames for the B2C modules (urun_ue/index.html:111-112, kareler/b2c_live_tr_icons.png).
findings.fix: Shoot each candidate set in two worlds: `live:a4_two_pm` (B2B: İlk Kullanım, Entegrasyonlar) and `live:b2c_live` (B2C: İlk Kullanım, Büyüme, Gelir). Name both in O1c and in the 'kanıt' column.

findings.quote: Uygun aday yoksa aynı ailenin üst kaynağından al; lisansı rapora yaz.
findings.problem: Nobody knows where assets/icons comes from, so there is no 'upstream of the same family' to use. Pulling icons from an unknown source would deepen an open release blocker. The prototype brief allowed only existing-set icons ('set dışından ikon alma'), and E4 says nothing on this. 'Aynı çizgi kalınlığı' is also the wrong test: the set is filled duotone (white fill plus a 0.4-opacity layer), not stroked lines.
findings.evidence: PRD_ANA_MENU_ONBOARDING.md:58 'assets/icons/ … kaynaksız' (L4) and :609 'assets/icons/ (91 SVG; L4, soru 6; yayın engeli) kaynağı' under 'Sahibe bırakılan kararlar'. prototip_gorevi.md §2. assets/icons/util/shield.svg uses fill paths, not strokes. The only licensed icon family in the repo is Lucide (assets/art/office/icons/LICENSE-lucide.txt), which is stroke-based.
findings.fix: Either limit candidates to the existing 91 SVGs (the brief's own 'Önce projenin kendi ikon setine bak' line), or name an allowed licensed source (for example Lucide, converted to the 24 px filled white style) and say that any candidate from outside the set is marked as such on the sheet for Erdem. Replace 'çizgi kalınlığı' with 'düz dolgulu beyaz, 24 px, aynı iki katmanlı stil'.

findings.quote: MCP'yle canlı koşuda bak: ikon keskin mi, koyu zeminde okunuyor mu?
findings.problem: The brief does not say how to get a live MCP run into the prototype world or the promise card. gopeak `editor-run` accepts only projectPath and scene, with no command-line args or env, so flags reach the game only through the copy's project.godot `run/main_args`. Every `--product-shot` and `--event-shot` ends in `_finish_shot`, which calls `get_tree().quit()`, so the 'live' run exits right after the shot. gopeak also does not apply mac_env's per-run HOME, so `user://` lands in Erdem's real HOME, which §9 forbids. The gopeak memory note gives the shared-tree path, which ORTAK §3 forbids for Godot runs. O2's 'MCP'de çip canlı okunur' has the same gap.
findings.evidence: main.gd:672-681 (`_finish_shot` ends in `get_tree().quit()`). main.gd:174-180 (main_args read only under the editor feature). gopeak editor-run schema: {projectPath, scene}. ORTAK_CALISMA §3 'Paylaşılan ağaçta … Godot koşulmaz'; §9 'Erdem'in gerçek HOME'u … hiçbir koşu oraya yazmaz'. Memory gopeak-runtime-verification-quirks gives 'Project path: …/project-unicorn' (shared tree).
findings.fix: Add a short MCP recipe: projectPath is the session's own copy only. State whether to start the runtime with `gd <ad> <copy> --path . <flag>` (windowed, own HOME, `ekran` lock) and attach to port 7777, or to use a temporary stay-alive world or harness scene in the copy. Say that project.godot and main_args edits in the copy are never committed.

findings.quote: Kendi scratchpad'ine `urun_arayuzu_devir/bin/`'in commit araçlarını kopyala ve `mac_env.sh`'ye bağla (`merge.sh`, `commit.sh`, `land.sh`, `linemerge.py`).
findings.problem:
The four named tools do not work alone and fail on this Mac.
- merge.sh, land.sh and commit.sh source env.sh and call export.sh, regen.sh, gate_copy.sh, theme_regen.sh and smoke.sh.
- smoke.sh uses `mapfile`, which the machine's only bash (3.2.57) does not have.
- regen.sh calls `python -I`, and there is no `python` on this Mac.
- land.sh runs smoke with `P=10`, against §9's limit of 2 per session.
- commit.sh and land.sh check lock ownership against a hardcoded `^URUN_ARAYUZU`, so OLAYLAR's commit aborts with 'kapı kilidi bende değil'.
The sibling brief's D0 spells these conversions out; this brief does not.
findings.evidence: bin/merge.sh:6,9,35; bin/land.sh:5,7,15,18,23 (`P=10`); bin/commit.sh:9 (`grep -q '^URUN_ARAYUZU'`); bin/smoke.sh:6 (`mapfile`); bin/regen.sh:5 (`python -I`); `bash --version` gives 3.2.57; `which python` finds nothing. GOREV_DIZUSTU_URUN D0: 'python → python3, smoke P=2'.
findings.fix: Copy the whole bin/ folder. Replace env.sh with a wrapper that sources mac_env.sh. Change `python` to `python3`, `mapfile` to a `while read` loop, APPDATA/cygpath to `gd`/HOME, `P` to 2 (CASE_TIMEOUT=300), and `URUN_ARAYUZU` to `$ETIKET`. Add 'all_scripts_load PASS after import and warm run' to O0's gate.

findings.quote: `promise_break` çipi de kartın kendi payını okur; `trust_delta` ile aynı kural (karar 1). … lint, `loc_residue`, B2B ve söz smoke vakaları, yeni ya da güncellenen vakanın mutasyonla düşmesi
findings.problem:
Three gaps in O2:
- It does not name the case it will break. `promise_break_chain` states and asserts the old rule: the chip equals the satisfaction one tick later, also inside the onboarding floor, and it will fail by design.
- 'Kartın kendi payı' is undefined for a broken promise. The brief does not say whether the share is the immediate -20 (`PROMISE_BROKEN_SAT`) plus the target move from the -12 ledger hit, or whether it also counts the raised tolerance bar (`_tolerance_after_break`) and the onboarding floor that the current case checks.
- It gives only 'before' numbers (slip 72 → 31) and no expected 'after', so 'done' cannot be checked.
findings.evidence: endgame_smoke.gd:25143-25149 docstring ('çipteki memnuniyet oyuncunun bir tik sonra okuduğu değerdir … onboarding çip iddiası') and :25191-25192, :25211-25213 (`account.satisfaction != int(plan.accounts[0].to)` after `advance_day`). b2b_sales_system.gd:112-123 (drop, ledger, `_forgiven_trust`, `_tolerance_after_break`, `_drift`); :102-107 `satisfaction_with_trust` (the trust_delta rule).
findings.fix: Name `promise_break_chain` as the case to rewrite. Define the break share in one line, for example 'sat + PROMISE_BROKEN_SAT + (target with ledger+offset and the raised bar − target now), no drift, no tick forgiveness', and say whether the onboarding floor counts. Give or require the expected after-values for slip and drop on the shot world.

findings.quote: Kanıt: `product.promise_due` `extend` ve `slip`, `team.promise_made` `ask_time` ve `drop` şıklarında önce ve sonra okuma
findings.problem: O2 omits the cleanup this change triggers. After 7c, `satisfaction_after_break` has no reader, because break_plan is its only caller, and CLAUDE §8 requires deleting it in the same commit. The hand-written system page also still documents it. Erdem's published Olaylar page shows `team.promise_made` frames with the old chip, and the brief does not say whether to re-shoot and republish them or mark them stale.
findings.evidence: `grep satisfaction_after_break scripts` finds only effects.gd:962 outside the smoke. docs/kod_haritasi/sistemler/03_satis_b2b.md:51 documents it. docs/tasks/olaylar_adim8/kareler/team.promise_made exists; the handover's 'Sayfada bir şey değişecekse' describes the republish procedure.
findings.fix: Add: delete `satisfaction_after_break` if it is dead and update 03_satis_b2b.md:51. For the Erdem page, either re-shoot `team.promise_made` and republish using the handover recipe (python3), or add one line to the 'Dizüstü turu' note saying the page's chip is stale.

findings.problem: This line does not match lint's real output, which has two spaces after PASS and a trailing arc count. An exact match against it would fail.
findings.evidence: scripts/events/tools/lint.gd:1339 `print("LINT %s  %d error(s), %d warning(s), %d baselined, %d card(s), %d arc(s)"`.
findings.fix: Quote the line as a prefix ('LINT PASS, 0 error(s), 0 warning(s), 10 baselined, 174 card(s)') or give the full format with arcs.

findings.problem: These memory files exist only in the repo-root project's memory folder. A session started in `project steam/` loads a different memory set that lacks them and that holds a gopeak note pointing at the shared tree. `godot-mcp-runtime-verification` also describes Windows and PowerShell steps.
findings.evidence: All five are in ~/.claude/projects/-Users-tugbauysal-Desktop-project-steam-Project-Unicorn/memory/. The ~/.claude/projects/-Users-tugbauysal-Desktop-project-steam/memory/ folder has only six unrelated files, including gopeak-runtime-verification-quirks.md.
findings.fix: Give the absolute memory folder, or say the session must start in '/Users/tugbauysal/Desktop/project steam/Project Unicorn'. Note that only the MCP quirks section of godot-mcp-runtime-verification applies on the Mac.

findings.quote: Her aday kümesi için `live:a4_two_pm` TR karesi, ayrıca 2× kırpma.
findings.problem: 'Aday kümesi' and '2× kırpma' are undefined. 'Aday kümesi' could mean three sets (candidate i of every module), or 12 single swaps. '2×' could mean a PIL upscale of a crop or `--shot-scale`. Unlike the sibling brief, this one also has no 'Sorular' rule: what to do when the PRD is silent, and that player-visible choices go to the co-director with two frames and a recommendation.
findings.evidence: GOREV_DIZUSTU_URUN has a 'Sorular' section ('co-director'e numaralı liste … Oyuncunun gördüğü yerleşim ve metin seçimleri iki kare ve önerinle gider'); the OLAYLAR brief has none.
findings.fix: Define the set as 'küme i = her modülün i. adayı (3 küme × 2 dünya)' and the crop as 'sol sütunun 1920×1080 karesinden kırpılıp nearest-neighbour 2× büyütülmüş PNG'. Copy the sibling brief's 'Sorular' section.

result.summary: A fresh session cannot run this brief end to end without going back to co-director or Erdem. Most paths, shot kinds, CSV keys and smoke names check out: a4_requests, a4_run_w2, a4_eleven and a4_two_pm are in _A4_WORLDS; b2b_requests and --shot-scale exist; window_layer.gd:39 SPECS product is 1424x928 and EDGE is 24; PROD_LINE_HIDDEN_SELF_SERVE (csv:1999), PROD_RND_NODE_SELF_SERVICE (csv:562, already "Yardım Merkezi") and PROD_RND_NODE_TEST_AUTOMATION_UNLOCK (csv:1974) exist; loc_residue.gd and glyph_audit.gd exist; loc_csv_integrity and all_scripts_load are smoke cases; there are 45 sprint_ cases and 9 product_ cases. Six defects block or steer the work wrongly. (1) D3/E1 rests on a quote, "a ile deneyelim", that the UE page only supports as the answer to section 3 ("Planda"/"Gelecek çeyrek"). The page has no comments, and §3(a) itself is never implemented. (2) D1 asks for a green tick on a met request, but the model drops met requests, and neither named world has one or a running sprint. (3) The D0 port list misses several macOS, bash 3.2 and 8 GB problems in the bin scripts. (4) The brief never says which tree the gopeak MCP opens, and the auto-loaded memory points it at the shared tree. (5) uk_a.patch goes against E6's "Boş yuva yer ayırmaz". (6) D8's PLANMS pass rule is undefined. The rest are smaller gaps.

findings.quote: D3 | **E1: Ürün penceresi genişler.** Genişliğin tamamı eksene gider, üç sütun yerinde kalır. ... commit `Ürün arayüzü UE1:`
findings.problem: D3 is a 3-hour commit that changes what the player sees. It rests on PRD E1's reading of Erdem's "a ile deneyelim" as "widen the Ürün window". The UE page Erdem reviewed offers no such option. Its only (a)/(b) pair is section 3: (a) "Planda"/"Gelecek çeyrek" written at name size, (b) a green tick. Erdem's next sentence ("yeşil tik olması kötü") rejects (b)'s tick, which fits the section 3 reading. If that reading is right, D3 builds something nobody chose, and the chosen §3(a) (module row "Planda" at name size) appears in no step of the brief.
findings.evidence: Artifact XHVbFN9e5qy49eKLJyfKrw (read): section 1 has a single before/after (left column 288→280) and no options; section 3 is the only '(a)'/'(b)'. ArtifactComments on it: no threads. GOREV_URUN_ARAYUZU_DEVAM Devir, 'Açık kararlar': 'UE: ... sol sütunun daralması, modül kısaltması yerine ikon, "planda"/"gelecek çeyrek" (a) ya da (b)'. There is no window-width option. The relayed user text has "ikonlardan sadece çekirdek ve güvenlik okay ... okay a ile deneyelim" right after the icons, in the page's order.
findings.fix: Before D3, co-director confirms with Erdem what "a" referred to. If it was section 3, replace D3 with §3(a) (module row "Planda" at name size, using the UE brief's new keys). Window widening then goes to Erdem as a new two-frame question.

findings.quote: D1 | ... Karşılanmış istek yeşil tik. ... Dünya `live:b2b_requests` ya da `a4_requests` (sol sütun, en az bir planlı, bir karşılanmış ve bir gelecek çeyrek isteği)
findings.problem: (a) Today a met request never reaches the left column, so there is no row to put a tick on. Showing met requests means deciding how long they stay listed, where they sort and whether they count toward the '+{n} talep' fold. Those are player-visible choices the brief makes silently. (b) Neither named world contains a met request. a4_requests is a planning world with no sprint played, and b2b_requests stops at the next planning. (c) Form (2), "Test %40", only exists in a running sprint (UK), so a planning world cannot show it. (d) `planned` covers this sprint only, while E5 also covers the next column.
findings.evidence: product_model.gd:287 `if r.status != "open" or customer == "": continue`; sprint_bridges.gd:108-109 sets `r.status = "met"`; product_model.gd:299 `planned = tags.get(card_id,-1) == SprintSystem.sprint_number()`; main.gd:4573 a4_requests = {crew, off, accounts:4} (no `run`, no `before`); main.gd:4522-4531 b2b_requests ends with `plan_next(); apply_lead()`.
findings.fix: Name a running-sprint B2B world (a new a4_* world in the copy) that has one planned, one met and one next-quarter request. Send the met-row rule (how long it stays, sort order, fold counting) to Erdem inside the same D1 frame pair, or state it explicitly as a co-director call.

findings.problem: The port list misses several things that break on this Mac or overrun 8 GB. /usr/bin/env bash is 3.2, so `mapfile` in smoke.sh fails, and land.sh always calls smoke.sh with `@list`. theme_regen.sh uses GNU `sed -i`; gnubin has no sed and gsed is not installed. z6.sh runs `xargs -P 7` Godot processes, team=50 among them. land.sh hard-codes `P=10`. a4.sh, shots.sh, z6.sh, runlog.sh, smoke.sh and quiet_planms*.sh start $GODOT directly, so they skip gd's GODOT_MAX and memory checks. Their user dirs use the Windows layout (`$ad/Godot/app_userdata`). quiet_planms2 counts processes with `tasklist //FI ... win64_console.exe`. If the scripts are switched to gd, gd returns 97 instead of waiting, so cases under xargs disappear silently, and gd, mem_ok and godots are not exported for the `bash -c` workers. ORTAK §9 also contradicts itself: 'en çok 2 Godot süreci (iki oturum ve MCP'nin editörü dahil)' against 'Smoke paralelliği oturum başına en çok 2'.
findings.evidence: `/usr/bin/env bash --version` → GNU bash 3.2.57; `which gsed` → not found; bin/smoke.sh `mapfile -t -O`; bin/theme_regen.sh `sed -i "s/^const THEME_STAMP..."`; bin/z6.sh `xargs -P 7`; bin/land.sh `P=10 bash "$S/bin/smoke.sh"`; bin/quiet_planms2.sh `tasklist //FI "IMAGENAME eq Godot_v4.6.2-stable_win64_console.exe"`; mac_env.sh gd `return 97` with no retry.
findings.fix: List every script and line to change: replace mapfile with a while-read loop; use `sed -i ''` or perl; z6 at -P 2 or one at a time; drop P=10; send every Godot start through a waiting gd (retry on 97/98/99) and export its helpers; set udir to the HOME layout; use pgrep in quiet_planms2. State one machine-wide rule: total of 2 Godot processes, so smoke runs at P=1 while the other session or MCP is running.

findings.quote: Görünür her adım commit'ten önce MCP'yle ve TR/EN karelerle doğrulanır (E3).
findings.problem: Neither the brief nor ORTAK §9 says which project tree gopeak's editor-launch opens. The memory this session loads automatically names the shared tree as the gopeak project path and suggests temporary `_debug_*` helpers in product_tab.gd. Following it would run import and edit code in the shared tree, which ORTAK §3 forbids. The editor plus its running game are already 2 Godot processes, the whole machine budget, so neither session can run anything else during an MCP check. The memory files the brief tells the agent to read live only in the memory folder for sessions started at the repo root; a session started anywhere else will not see them.
findings.evidence: ~/.claude/projects/-Users-tugbauysal-Desktop-project-steam/memory/gopeak-runtime-verification-quirks.md: 'Project path: `/Users/tugbauysal/Desktop/project steam/Project Unicorn/project-unicorn`' and 'add temporary `_debug_*` helpers to ... `product_tab.gd`'. ORTAK §3: 'Paylaşılan ağaçta kod değiştirilmez, Godot koşulmaz, `--import` hiç koşulmaz.' The five named memories exist only under ~/.claude/projects/-Users-tugbauysal-Desktop-project-steam-Project-Unicorn/memory/.
findings.fix: Add: 'gopeak editor-launch only on your own copy ($S/work/project-unicorn), never on the shared tree; take the ekran lock first; the editor plus the game count as 2 Godot processes; editor-stop when done.' Give the memory files as absolute paths.

findings.problem: Re-cutting the patch as written contradicts E6. In a running sprint the patch always adds the status slot, even when it is empty, with min width D_W_CARD_SLOT, so an empty slot takes space against 'Boş yuva yer ayırmaz'. The patch also hides the due chip and "devreden" whenever "{aşama} %{n}" shows. That reads §UK 3a's 'sıra' as a priority, not as a sequence of items shown together. Under that reading a promised card in a running sprint loses its due chip, which is a player-visible choice nobody made. The patch adds the key PRODUCT_STAGE_PCT, but the D2 commit evidence never asks for 'TR/EN onay bekliyor'.
findings.evidence: uk_a.patch: `-\t\tif not slot.is_empty():` / `+\t\tif not slot.is_empty() or _ctx.mode == "active":`; `_status` keeps `cell.custom_minimum_size.x = UiTokens.D_W_CARD_SLOT`; `_show_stage_pct`: `part.visible = text == ""` for every other part; `+PRODUCT_STAGE_PCT,{stage} {pct},{stage} {pct}`. PRD E6: 'Boş yuva yer ayırmaz.'
findings.fix: Tell the agent the patch is only a guide: an empty slot takes no width. Decide whether the percentage replaces the due chip or sits beside it. If the uk/frames do not already settle it, send it to Erdem with two frames. Add PRODUCT_STAGE_PCT to the commit's TR/EN pending list.

findings.quote: D8 | PLANMS (sessiz kilit, D0'ın göreli tabanına karşı)
findings.problem: No pass/fail rule. The Devir note this step implements asks for an absolute measurement with a gate ('Mutlak PLANMS ... kapı ≤ 100 ms'). The brief instead says relative to D0, with no threshold, and the 100 ms gate was set on the Windows machine, so it does not carry over to an M1. D8 also says nothing about blocking on OLAYLAR: quiet_planms waits until no Godot process is left.
findings.evidence: GOREV_URUN_ARAYUZU_DEVAM Devir item 5: '**Mutlak PLANMS** ... U8'den önce sessiz ölçüm (`bin/quiet_planms2.sh`; U5'te HEAD 78 ms, U2 ağacı 95 ms, kapı ≤ 100 ms)'. PRD §13 U2: '`PLANMS` ilk kare 50 kişide ≤ 100 ms'.
findings.fix: State the gate. For example: final HEAD ≤ D0 base +10% (same machine, same quiet procedure, n runs, median), plus the absolute value reported for information. Note that the 100 ms Windows gate is suspended on the laptop, or get co-director to restate it.

findings.quote: `live:a4_run_w2` TR/EN, `a4_eleven` EN; `sprint_`/`product_` vakaları; Z6 D0 referansıyla bayt eş
findings.problem: The Z6 reference is pinned to D0. OLAYLAR commits to main in parallel (O2), and z6.sh runs with `events=1`, so a change in its lines after HEAD moves could be blamed on UK. Earlier commits compared Z6 with their parent's own run.
findings.evidence: bin/z6.sh: `--sprint-probe=...:fill=1:events=1$ex`; d1eb210 message: 'Sprint probu (Z6) 287f6f5'in kendi koşusuyla bayt eş'; GOREV_DIZUSTU_OLAYLAR_IKON O2 commits `Olaylar 7c:`.
findings.fix: Say: if HEAD has moved since D0, rerun Z6 on the new HEAD (the merge base) and compare with that run.

findings.quote: Üst sınır pencere alanıdır (alan eksi iki `EDGE`) [PRD E1, D3 için tek ölçü]
findings.problem: D3 gives a maximum but no target. The window area depends on the rail's live width, which changes with its mode. The brief does not say whether SPECS["product"] gets a fixed new width (and which) or grows to fill the area. The 'bir haftanın px'i' figure, and so the before/after frames Erdem compares, depend on that choice.
findings.evidence: window_layer.gd:200-201 `_area()`: `corner := Vector2(rail.get_rect().end.x - position.x + EDGE, EDGE)`; :222 `_fit` returns `spec.min(room)`; comment at :54 'genişliği kipine göre değişir'.
findings.fix: Give the rule: e.g. product width = area width at 1920×1080 with the default rail mode, as a constant in SPECS, with `_fit` unchanged. Write the resulting px in the brief.

findings.quote: Panoda iki satırdan sonra "…" ile ÇEYREK EN adları (`u7_todo.txt`) kalkar.
findings.problem: The sentence is garbled: it merges two separate cuts into one item. The long-name worlds u7_todo cites (a4_two_pm_long, a4_fifty_long) were never committed. They existed only in the UE prototype on Windows, so 'en uzun EN adlı kartla pano ve ÇEYREK kareleri' has no ready world.
findings.evidence: u7_todo.txt: 'a4_two_pm_long / a4_fifty_long'da panoda uzun kart adları 2 satırdan sonra "…"'; `grep a4_two_pm_long scripts/main/main.gd` → none; only `"fill": "long"` (main.gd:4570, a4_eleven_tip).
findings.fix: Rewrite as two items: (1) the board card name cut after two lines with "…" (board_row.gd OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS); (2) EN card names split or cut in ÇEYREK's SprintCard narrow view. Name the frame worlds (e.g. a4_eleven_tip's fill:long, live:b2b_quarter EN) or ask for a4_two_pm_long to be recreated.

findings.quote: D5 | ... Ar-Ge postası ve düzeltme kartı karesi; commit `Ürün arayüzü UM1:`
